description: Invent a fresh, unused disposable email address you can give out immediately. Nothing is created or reserved server-side — an address exists as soon as mail arrives at it — so this never fails and needs no account. Public domains: grabmail.io, mixozia.com, linqmail.com. With a paid key sent as Authorization: Bearer, a premium-pool domain from list_domains works too.

domain.description: Which domain to use: a public domain (grabmail.io, mixozia.com, linqmail.com), or, with a paid key, one of the premium-pool domains returned by list_domains. Defaults to grabmail.io.

prefix.description: Optional readable prefix; a random suffix is added so it stays unique.

name: create_inbox
title: Create a disposable inbox
